bounded_slice.candidate: W3C PROV-DM as the provenance envelope layer around the previously selected RFC 8785 canonical JSON representation
bounded_slice.tested_scope: Static inspection of exactly the official W3C PROV-DM Recommendation in this invocation. No second public source, implementation, runtime execution, external service, protected-primary action, or manual-user execution was consumed.
observations: PROV-DM defines provenance as information about entities, activities, and people involved in producing data or things and is intended to support quality, reliability, and trust assessments.
Its six-component model covers entities/activities with lifecycle timing, derivations, agents/responsibility, bundles for provenance-of-provenance, alternate/specialized entities, and collections.

The core model includes Entity, Activity, Agent and relations for generation, usage, communication, derivation, attribution, association, and delegation; this directly supplies structured source/process/responsibility linkage missing from p1-sa-552.

PROV-DM is domain-agnostic and explicitly provides extensibility points for domain/application-specific information, so an evidence package can add role-specific observation, inference, uncertainty, checkpoint, and continuation attributes without treating those additions as native PROV semantics.

PROV-DM is a conceptual provenance model rather than a canonical JSON encoding, cryptographic integrity mechanism, content digest, replay procedure, or persistence transport. It therefore complements rather than replaces RFC 8785 and does not by itself prove package-byte integrity or executable replay.
bounded_slice.inference: Within the exact inspected scope, PROV-DM is a strong candidate provenance-envelope layer for the evidence-handoff package because it can identify the evidence entity, the activity that produced it, responsible agents, derivation links to source entities, and bundles carrying provenance of provenance. Combined conceptually with the previously selected RFC 8785 deterministic JSON representation, it closes much of the provenance/source-responsibility field gap. However, full replay-package acceptance remains unresolved because this slice did not define or test a concrete JSON mapping, integrity/content-digest binding, explicit observation-versus-inference-versus-uncertainty schema, or replay/continuation procedure.
bounded_slice.uncertainty: No claim is made that PROV-DM alone mandates the exact evidence-package fields, canonical serialization, hashes/signatures, uncertainty semantics, or replay algorithm needed here. No PROV-O/PROV-N/PROV-JSON mapping, implementation conformance, or interoperability test was inspected in this one-source slice.
bounded_slice.residual_richer_mode_protected_manual_us: 0 for the specification-level provenance model inspected here; concrete serialization, integrity binding, and replay execution remain separate unresolved children and are not claimed solved.
bounded_slice.quota_zero_assessment: The W3C specification itself is a public static standard and the inspected provenance-model mechanism has no required hosted compute, paid API, monthly/trial credit, or external execution dependency. This does not establish quota-zero behavior of any implementation because no implementation was tested.
bounded_slice.conflict_check: CLEAN-safe: semantically consumed only frozen sanitized controls, own role-local p1-sa-552/LATEST state, and one official public W3C primary source; no O/O-derived, downstream, other-worker, shared-ledger, protected-primary, manual-user, or scheduler semantic input was used.
